mapper.select: select l.id,l.account_id,l.region_id,l.super_admin_id,l.role_code,l.operation_type,case when l.operation_type = 'CREATE_GUILD' then coalesce(cast(captain.chat_no as char), l.target) else l.target end as target,l.content,l.create_time,a.login_name,sa.login_name as super_admin_name from external_operation_log l join external_manager_account a on a.id=l.account_id left join external_manager_account sa on sa.id=l.super_admin_id left join fm_family f on l.operation_type = 'CREATE_GUILD' and l.target = cast(f.family_id as char) left join `user` captain on captain.uid = f.uid and a.login_name like concat('%',#{loginName},'%')and sa.login_name like concat('%',#{superAdminName},'%')and l.operation_type=#{operationType}and l.region_id=#{regionId}and l.create_time >= #{beginTime}and l.create_time <= #{endTime} order by l.id desc
select id,account_id,region_id,super_admin_id,role_code,operation_type,target,content,create_time from external_operation_log where account_id=#{accountId} order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.delete: delete from external_operation_log where operation_type='CREATE_SUBORDINATE' and target=#{target}
mapper.select: select count(1) from external_operation_log where account_id=#{accountId} and operation_type=#{operationType} and create_time >= curdate()
